name: Dark Iron Ambassador
summary: Deep within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan lurks the Dark Iron Ambassador, an elusive emissary sent by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. His presence reveals that the fall of the gnome capital involves far more than just wild trogg incursions and madness.

sections.title: A Shadowy Envoy
sections.body: While Gnomeregan's catastrophic downfall is publicly blamed on the trogg invasion and High Tinker Mekkatorque's desperate radiation gambit, the presence of the Dark Iron Ambassador points to far darker machinations. Wandering the contaminated depths of the workshop corridors, this rare Dark Iron dwarf suggests that Sicco Thermaplugg did not betray his people in complete isolation.

sections.title: Conspiracies in the Deep
sections.body: The true motives behind Emperor Thaurissan's envoy remain cloaked in secrecy and speculation. Both Alliance investigators in Ironforge and Horde-affiliated goblins have raised theories about the Dark Iron clan's involvement in the subterranean disaster. Rumors swirl that the Dark Irons offered technical expertise, aided Thermaplugg in operating heavy machinery like the subterranean super rig, or brokered a vile pact to undercut Ironforge from below.

faq.q: Who is the Dark Iron Ambassador?
faq.answer: He is an envoy of the Dark Iron clan found deep inside the irradiated ruin of Gnomeregan. His role is that of a diplomatic representative between Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and the rogue forces controlling the fallen city.

faq.q: Why is a Dark Iron dwarf inside Gnomeregan?
aliases: why are dark irons in gnomeregan
faq.answer: His presence strongly suggests secret negotiations between the Dark Iron clan and the mad usurper Sicco Thermaplugg. The Dark Irons appear to have had a hand in assisting Thermaplugg or exploiting Gnomeregan's disaster for their own ends against Ironforge.

faq.q: Did the Dark Irons help cause the fall of Gnomeregan?
aliases: did dark irons cause trogg invasion
faq.answer: While the trogg invasion itself drove the initial crisis, in-universe conspiracies and goblin observers suggest the Dark Irons secretly assisted Thermaplugg. They may have aided in drilling operations or provided technical help with advanced subterranean equipment.

faq.q: Where does the ambassador come from?
faq.answer: He represents the Dark Iron clan, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan from their stronghold beneath the Blackrock Mountain. He was dispatched to treat with Gnomeregan's traitorous new leadership.

faq.q: Is he allied with Sicco Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: Yes, evidence strongly points to an alliance. As an envoy, his survival among Thermaplugg's leper gnomes and mechanostriders demonstrates an ongoing diplomatic link rather than hostility between the two factions.

faq.q: Where can the Dark Iron Ambassador be found?
faq.answer: He is an elusive, rare encounter who wanders the contaminated engineering sectors and workshop corridors inside the Gnomeregan dungeon.

angles.text: Finding a Dark Iron envoy in Gnomeregan proves the horrific betrayal that poisoned your home was backed by dwarf enemies from Blackrock.
Your ancient Dark Iron kin have wormed their way into the gnome halls, demonstrating that Thaurissan's reach threatens Khaz Modan from within.
The ambassador's secret dealings with Thermaplugg represent an active hostile front right on the doorstep of Ironforge.
